Baritone saxophonist Gary Smulyan was born on April 4, 1956 in Bethpage, New York. His first big band work with Woody Herman was followed by stints with the Mel Lewis Orchestra, the Phillip Morris Superband and the Vanguard Jazz Orchestra. He has shared the stage and studio with Nick Brignola, Joe Lovano and Benny Green, and currently records as a leader on Criss Cross Records.
Gary was interviewed in Utica, New York on October 17, 2010 by Monk Rowe, director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
